tasks.title: Update MCP documentation for @-mention removal
tasks.description: Claude Code removed the ability to @-mention MCP servers to enable/disable them. Update all WogiFlow documentation to use `/mcp enable <name>` instead.
tasks.userStory: As a WogiFlow user, I want accurate documentation so that I can correctly enable/disable MCP servers.

acceptanceCriteria.when: They look for how to enable MCP servers
acceptanceCriteria.then: They find instructions using `/mcp enable <name>` syntax

tasks.title: Enable nested skills directory discovery
tasks.description: Update flow-skill-matcher.js and related scripts to support nested skill directories. This enables hierarchical organization like `.claude/skills/frontend/react/` and workspace-specific skills in monorepos.
tasks.userStory: As a developer working on a large project, I want to organize skills hierarchically so that I can better categorize domain-specific patterns.

acceptanceCriteria.then: The nested skill is discovered and can be matched
The flat skill is still discovered (backward compatible)
All skills are shown with their full paths

acceptanceCriteria.when: Adding a nested skill path like 'frontend/react'

tasks.title: Create status line integration skill
tasks.description: Create a new skill/command `/wogi-statusline-setup` that configures Claude Code's status line to show WogiFlow-specific information like current task, context percentage, and active skill.
tasks.userStory: As a WogiFlow user, I want to see my current task and context usage in the Claude Code status line so that I have constant visibility into my workflow state.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A task is in progress (ready.json has inProgress)
acceptanceCriteria.then: The current task ID and title appear in the status line
The .claude/settings.local.json is updated with status line config

acceptanceCriteria.given: User wants to customize status line format
acceptanceCriteria.then: Can choose between compact, detailed, or minimal formats

technicalNotes: Reference: Claude Code status line documentation

tasks.title: Enhance context monitor with native tracking
tasks.description: Enhance flow-context-monitor.js to optionally use Claude Code's native context_window tracking instead of manual token estimation. This provides more accurate context usage data.
tasks.userStory: As a WogiFlow user, I want accurate context usage information so that I know exactly when to compact.

acceptanceCriteria.then: The native percentage is used instead of estimation

acceptanceCriteria.given: Native tracking is not available (non-Claude Code CLI)
acceptanceCriteria.then: Falls back to token estimation method

technicalNotes: The native tracking may require reading from Claude Code's internal state
Consider: How to access Claude Code's context window data from scripts
